The Laguna Coffee Table is 100% solid, plantation grown teak. Whether allowed to weather or maintained to keep it’s natural, warm golden look, it will be a striking addition to your patio setting. It is designed to match the entire Laguna collection.

  • Our Plantation Teak products are plantation-grown and harvested from mature trees that are 50-60 years old.

  • This line of teak is part of a replenished forestry program, where a new tree is planted for each one that is harvested
  • A wire wheel is used to distress the reclaimed wood to enhance the grain and provide a rustic finish.
